_readme: Own-property guard test. The OscA below carries hostile param keys (__proto__, constructor, toString, hasOwnProperty) that a bare params[k] lookup would resolve through the prototype chain, writing .value onto Object.prototype or shared built-ins. The connections list carries hostile port names (toString/hasOwnProperty) and a duplicate of the real cable: connect() must reject all three, so exactly ONE cable renders after import and re-exporting the patch drops the bad tuples. Import this patch: it must load with 'Imported!', the OscA must show coarse +5 / level 0.3, a quiet saw drone must reach the Output, one cable only, and in the console Object.prototype.value and ({}).toString must be untouched (undefined / native function).
